component.name: PixelFlow
component.summary: A minimal video player and media space with gesture controls

description.p: PixelFlow is a modern media player offering a clean dark theme, folder-based browsing, and on-screen touch and mouse gestures for rapid brightness, volume, and timeline scrub control.

ul.li: Vertical gestures for display brightness and audio volume with real-time HUD meters
Audio volume boost up to 200% and night mode speech clarity
Custom SRT/VTT subtitle loader with extensive styling options
Organized folder and video views with continue watching watch history
